faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the Dell Precision 3540/3550, Latitude 5400/5410/5500/5510, and the 2-in-1 versions of the Inspiron 7590/7591/7791 (not the standard clamshell versions). The part number on your old battery is the safest way to confirm. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker on your battery on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.
